> **Capability note.** This file is the DEPRECATED custom-prompts twin
> (`--skills=codex-prompts`); `fathom init --skills=codex` writes the skill

## 1. Import

```sh
fathom findings import --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --subject $SUBJECT --file $FILE --json
```

`--subject` must equal the event's own subject exactly (`.fathom/config.toml`'s
`[findings] subject`). A producer not in the catalog, or a `fathom`-origin
producer, is refused — never silently accepted. Already runs automatically
once per session when `[findings] outbox` is configured; run this by hand
for an outbox not wired in, or to see the receipt directly.

## 2. Dry-run first

```sh
fathom findings import --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --subject $SUBJECT --file $FILE --dry-run --json
```

Same validation, same receipt shape, writes nothing — run this before
trusting a new producer or a freshly wired subject.

## 3. Inspect

```sh
fathom findings status     --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --json
fathom findings near       <symbol|file> --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --json
fathom findings candidates --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --min-sites 3 --json
```

`status` adds `candidates`/`disagreements` counts for the loop. `candidates`
is a REPORT — fathom never writes a rule; a human promotes one into
`CLAUDE.md`/`.fathom/guard.cue`.

## 4. Refute or corroborate

```sh
fathom claim refute|corroborate --store $STORE --service $SERVICE --claim ID --note "..."
```

Works identically on an imported finding. Always a human verdict recorded
against fathom's own claim — never a write-back to the review kit's own
journal.

## 5. Read the receipt honestly

Exit code 1 on ANY `rejected` entry, even with other deliveries in the same
batch. `stale` and `duplicate` are both no-ops but mean different things —
report which. Rejection reasons: `subject-mismatch`, `unknown-producer`,
`circular` (fathom-origin, refused by design), `conflicting-replay` (same
version, different payload — re-derive from the review kit's own archive).
`docs/adoption/findings-loop.md` has the full troubleshooting list.

## 6. What fathom never does

Never approves, disputes, tailors, or closes a review-kit finding on its
own authority; never becomes the organizational record. A served finding
is advisory — only a human-promoted rule in `CLAUDE.md`/`guard.cue` ever
enforces. Say this explicitly when asked what an import "did."
